tool.name: OGS: convertGEO
tool.description: Converts OGS geometry file into another file format.
tool.command: ln -sf '$input_file' 'input_file.gml'; #if $gmsh_path ln -sf '$gmsh_path' 'gmsh_path.msh'; #end if convertGEO --input-file 'input_file.gml' #if $gmsh_path --gmsh-path 'gmsh_path.msh' #end if --output-file output_1.gml

param.label: input file
param.help: Input (.gml|.gli). The name of the geometry file to be converted (the wrapper accepts .gml only)

param.label: gmsh path
param.help: Input (.msh). The path to the gmsh binary file

tool.help: Converts OGS geometry file into another file format. Currently \*.gml (OGS6 XML-based format) and \*.gli (OGS5 format) formats are supported.
